The delivery report for `greeting-release` is written to `.feature-flow/greeting-release/delivery.md`. It stayed in the sandbox because the run has no durable path set. There are no delivery gaps: the only migration task (Task 2, `003_add_locale.sql`) has a rollback step in the plan.

| Section | Source |
|---|---|
| Release notes | The spec's two acceptance criteria. There's no decision record, so the approach comes from the design (a `--greeting` flag plus a numbered SQL migration). |
| Deployment checklist | A generic ordered list: back up the DB, deploy off-peak, deploy the code, apply migration 003, validate. It's based on the migration task and the verify commands, so adjust it to your real deploy process. |
| Rollback checklist | Copied row for row from the plan's rollback section (Task 1: `git checkout`; Task 2: drop the `locale` column and remove the migration file). |
| Migration notes | Task 2 plus its risk (it may lock `users` on large tables; run it off-peak). Rolling back drops any locale values written since deploy. |
| Known issues | From verify: existing rows default to `locale = 'en'`, with no backfill from user settings. |
| Release validation | The two commands verify ran, to re-run after deploy. The migration command should be run against a scratch copy, not production. |

The manifest now records `phases.deliver` as complete and `artifacts.delivery` points at the report. `currentPhase` is still `"done"`.
